strategicConstraints: Prefer Mew V and Genesect V board construction, then Mew VMAX evolution.
Use Wally only when a Mew V entered play this turn and the Supporter resource is available.
Use Genesect V Fusion Strike System only when hand size is below the number of Fusion Strike Pokémon in play.
Prefer Mew VMAX Cross Fusion Strike copying a Benched Genesect V Techno Blast when that attack is offered.
Cross Fusion Strike pays its own Colorless cost; do not charge the donor attack cost again without native evidence.
Use copied Energy Mix only as a Cross Fusion Strike line and target DCE from the deck.
Do not assume standalone Mew V Energy Mix/Psychic Leap, Mew VMAX Max Miracle, Genesect Techno Blast, or Clefairy Full Moon Rondo are payable from the source's DCE-only energy base.
Sequence own draw abilities before Path to the Peak; Path suppresses Rule Box abilities on both sides, including Genesect Fusion Strike System and Shadow Rider VMAX Underworld Door.
Preserve the last Mew VMAX and scarce DCE during Ultra Ball/Secret Box discard selection.
Use opponent-visible prize liability and remaining HP for Guzma target selection; do not inspect hidden cards.
